title: Verified candidate handoff to independently owned Rasen Falcon site compiler
summary: v0.4 exports a candidate/0.1 document, accepted by independently owned Rasen Falcon v0.2 stage-publisher and preview compiler; there is no authenticated release.
invariants: The website editor exports all nine candidate page records, CANDIDATE_ONLY, without publishing credentials.
Rasen Falcon stage-publisher is owned separately, validates duplicate keys, identity and schema, stages atomically and refuses overwrites.
Staged state remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED, authority NONE; imported native revision is unverified; CMS and Wire receipts remain empty.
Preview build remains noindex,nofollow and robots Disallow; production build rejects. Local SHA-256 does not authenticate review or publication.
Python is only an offline site-build tool, not a runtime HTTP server, application authority or NoSQL storage path.

provenance.claim: v0.4 editor and 36 executable cross-package acceptance checks
Independently owned staging/preview contract actually exercised
